name: PlayNav
description: Beta. Pokemon-Amie and Super Training from X, Y, Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire on a DS-style touch screen (split screen, or a second display such as the AYN Thor). Pet your Pokemon, feed it Poke Puffs, play the Amie minigames, decorate its room and train its EVs. Gen 1, 2 and 3.

optional_imports.name: Alpha Sapphire or Omega Ruby (USA), decrypted .cci / .3ds / .cia
optional_imports.description: Supplies the 3DS art and English text for Pokemon-Amie and Super Training, unpacked on your device. Any decrypted Omega Ruby or Alpha Sapphire dump works (card image, trimmed or not, CIA, or Azahar's compressed .zcci); PlayNav checks each piece it uses and draws its own for any that differ. Optional: without it, PlayNav plays with its own art, sounds, words and music. The copy can be removed from Imported files once the art has been extracted.
